name: The Vogel Farms
tagline: Link to The Vogel Farms Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/The
description: In 067 West Ashby Road, AL, The Vogel Farms raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Check the website for current hours and availability.
